newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Advanced Micro. [CORRECTED 21:01 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Advanced Micro. [CORRECTED 21:01 GMT]

text.p: Citing Advanced Micro Devices Inc's progress in producing its K6 microprocessor and lowering its inventory, Prudential Securities analyst Mark Edelstone (corrects last name) hiked his estimate of AMD's 1997 earnings to $1.25 a share from $0.70 a share previously, he said in a report.
Edelstone also upgraded his rating on AMD to a buy from a hold, as earlier reported.
Edelstone said he expects AMD will lose money again this quarter but 1997 results will reflect "an end to the inventory correction," and AMD's ramp of K6 into volume production.
AMD shares rose 2-1/8 to 23-3/4 in heavy trading.
